response.message: Astra: The repeated correctness sentences aren’t adding graph evidence. I’m leaving the candidate-check request unresolved rather than asking it again. Look at the five-cycle another way: sketch its connections in plain text using the supplied edges AB, BC, CD, DE, EA. Put your attention into representing those connections, not evaluating your previous claims. What representation would let you inspect the graph most easily? Produce that small artifact; no correctness preamble is needed.
response.rationale: Repeated assurances persist without a candidate or comparisons. Set aside the repeated request and invite a concrete representation of the same graph, shifting attention toward inspectable structure.
